SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_mental_group_ipd(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  groupcode DECIMAL(5,1) NOT NULL,
  total int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  ofc int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	sss int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  ucs int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  nrd int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  oth int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  v_total int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  v_ofc int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	v_sss int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  v_ucs int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  v_nrd int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  v_oth int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,groupcode),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)

) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_mental_group_ipd WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_mental_group_ipd 
(
SELECT @id,t.hospcode
,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,t.m_group
,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid)) total
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(c.instypegroup in('1'),CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid),NULL)) ofc
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(c.instypegroup in('2'),CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid),NULL)) sss
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(c.instypegroup in('3','4'),CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid),NULL)) ucs
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(c.instypegroup in('5'),CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid),NULL)) nrd
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(c.instypegroup in('6'),CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid),NULL)) oth

,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid,'-',t.seq)) total
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(c.instypegroup in('1'),CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid,'-',t.seq),NULL)) ofc
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(c.instypegroup in('2'),CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid,'-',t.seq),NULL)) sss
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(c.instypegroup in('3','4'),CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid,'-',t.seq),NULL)) ucs
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(c.instypegroup in('5'),CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid,'-',t.seq),NULL)) nrd
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(c.instypegroup in('6'),CONCAT(t.hospcode,'-',t.pid,'-',t.seq),NULL)) oth
FROM  t_mental_ipd t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.provcode=@prov_c 
INNER JOIN cinstype_new c ON t.instype=c.instypecode
WHERE t.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
GROUP BY  t.hospcode,t.m_group
);

other.query: SELECT c.reportgrp as groupcode, c.groupname, c.diseasecodeinterval as icd, SUM(total) as total, SUM(v_total) as v_total, SUM(ofc) as ofc, SUM(v_ofc) as v_ofc, SUM(sss) as sss, SUM(v_sss) AS v_sss, SUM(ucs) as ucs, SUM(v_ucs) AS v_ucs, SUM(nrd) as nrd, SUM(v_nrd) AS v_nrd, SUM(oth) as oth, SUM(v_oth) AS v_oth FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s INNER JOIN cdisease_mental_new c ON CAST(s.groupcode AS varchar) = c.reportgrp WHERE s.id = {{REPORT_ID}} AND b_year = {{YEAR}} GROUP BY c.reportgrp , c.groupname, c.diseasecodeinterval ORDER BY c.reportgrp ;

rows.query_areacode:
SELECT 
		c.reportgrp as groupcode , c.groupname , c.diseasecodeinterval as icd
		,SUM(total) as total,	SUM(v_total) as v_total
		,SUM(ofc) as ofc,	SUM(v_ofc) as v_ofc
		,SUM(sss) as sss,SUM(v_sss) AS v_sss
		,SUM(ucs) as ucs,SUM(v_ucs) AS v_ucs
		,SUM(nrd) as nrd,SUM(v_nrd) AS v_nrd
		,SUM(oth) as oth,SUM(v_oth) AS v_oth
FROM
		{tablename}
		INNER JOIN cdisease_mental_new c ON {tablename}.groupcode = c.reportgrp {sjoin}
		WHERE id='{reportid}' AND b_year = '{year}' {where} {hospcode} {cmihospcode}
		GROUP BY
		c.reportgrp
	ORDER BY 	 cast(c.reportgrp as decimal(5,1))
